billingExports.description: Billing account ID → fully-qualified BigQuery standard usage cost export table. Accounts not listed are reported as 'Costs unavailable — export not configured'.

runRegions.description: Fallback regions for Cloud Run if the global v1 list is unavailable.

quotaProject.description: Project used for x-goog-user-project and as the BigQuery job project. Defaults to the ADC quota project, then the export table's project.

maxBytesBilled.description: Hard cap per BigQuery job, bytes. Default 1 GiB.

ttlOverrides.description: Seconds. Defaults: alerts 300, resources 900, projects 3600, services 3600, costs 14400, budgets 14400, storageSize 21600.

nodePath.description: Absolute path to node for the SwiftBar shim, if not found on the default search path.
